history.summary: Plan completed: pre-settled shape, one GitSyncDeploy phase (github:pvginkel/GitSyncDeploy) disabling explicit GC on gitblit-app with the 1024M heap kept and dropping its CPU request; luceneFrequency is a test-phase contingency. verification.json carries V01 (R1 near-idle bar) plus fix, D2 and rollout criteria; dry-run parses.

The criteria match R1 and rulings D1 and D2 one to one, and the DisableExplicitGC design checks out against Gitblit 1.10.0's source and the pinned image's entrypoint (Java 8, a JAVA_OPTS default of -Xmx1024M). The Target and the single phase are sound. The one advisory note is that the timing of the one-hour near-idle reading is left to the test agent.
